message.text: Review policy and standards changed in this revision.

explanation.what: This revision changes AGENTS.md, which steers how Melian reviews this repository.
explanation.whatToDo: Have a maintainer read the change to AGENTS.md before merging.
explanation.whyHere: Melian reviewed the revision under the policy and standards it changes, so nothing it ran judged the new ones.

snippet.text: AGENTS.md's Three reviews before ready, step 3 of The loop for one step, and the review-of-record brief's first line now say that Codex's adversarial review, a Melian round and the Claude review of record all run first on one commit, the first head a builder pushes with its gate green, and that the builder pushes no fix until all three have reported. After the merge the coordinator has a Sonnet agent write the pull request's defect list from the three reviews and the fix commits. [The decision](../decisions/2026-11-27-three-reviews-on-one-first-head.md) says why.

snippet.text: After the merge, the coordinator has a Sonnet agent write the pull request's defect list for its comparison record: each distinct defect a reviewer raised on the first reviewed head, who raised it, and the commit that fixed it or the builder's answer disputing it. A finding that a later commit fixed, with a failing test first, counts as real. The coordinator spot-checks a sample.
